messages:
maria: Quick note — planning a staggered canary for the Console frontend today at 15:00 PT. Intend to roll 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~30m windows. Need CDN cache-bust during the 25% step and smoke checks at each stage. Who can own deploy / purge / smoke?

devon: I can run the deploys. Will start the canary at 15:00 PT and monitor.

ashley: I can trigger the CDN invalidation. Will wait for the 25% go-ahead.

liam: I'll own smoke tests (UX and API checks). I'll post minimal checklist and scripts here.

maria: Thanks — plan is: 15:00 start canary (5%), 15:30 bump to 25% + CDN purge, 16:00 full rollout if no regressions. Rollback plan: immediate rollback to previous tagged asset and cancel purge if we see asset mismatch.

devon: Confirmed. I'll annotate the deploy with canary tag `canary-177430` and keep CI logs open.

liam: Smoke checklist (quick):
- login flow (happy path)
- settings page load (client assets)
- primary API: /v1/rerank (sample prompt)
- console metrics: 95th latency and error rate < baseline + 5%

liam: Smoke commands:```bash
# check site static assets status
curl -I https://console.redwood.ai/static/app.js | grep -i etag
# basic API check
curl -s -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/rerank -d '{"q":"test"}' | jq .status
```

ashley: CDN purge command I'm going to run at the 25% bump (we have CloudFront):```bash
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E3ABCDEF12345 --paths "/static/*" --profile redwood-prod
```
I'll post invalidation id once submitted.

ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance window note required for multi-region cache busts.

maria: Good catch ops-bot — no user-facing downtime but posting brief note to #general now.

devon: Can someone watch Sentry and real-user sessions for the first 15 minutes after each ramp? I can watch deploy logs, but need eyes on errors.

liam: I'll watch Sentry and sampling of RUM. Will ping if new error spikes or asset 404s show up.

ashley: Invalidation queued. ID: I3INVALID12345. ETA ~90s.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout (canary-177430) 5% started by devon — monitoring hooks enabled.

maria: If any blocker appears, immediate rollback and hold release until follow-up. Otherwise we proceed to 25% at 15:30 PT.

devon: Understood. I'll post when bumping to 25%.

liam: Quick pre-deploy note: if you see mismatched asset hashes, DO NOT proceed to 100%. We'll capture HARs and revert.

maria: Thanks team — will update after 25% bump. :thumbsup:
